data.description: Live in the future of urban living amongst business and aviation facilities.

data.answer:
The community features an integrated ecosystem of 145 square kilometers and residential projects for up to 1 million residents. Sustainability is a key focus of Dubai South's development strategy. The city incorporates green building practices, renewable energy sources, water conservation measures, and waste management systems to + promote eco-friendly living.

The Expo 2020 Site is one of the flagship projects within the Dubai South master plan, which hosted the prestigious World Expo event. The site includes purpose-built pavilions, exhibition spaces, and infrastructure designed to accommodate millions of visitors.

The Dubai South Residential District reimagines urban living by creating a world-class community centered on the happiness and well-being of its residents. With its distinctive design, top-notch construction, and an array of lifestyle amenities, all conveniently located near the Expo City site and Al Maktoum International Airport, it stands out as an ideal living environment. Let’s check out the different types of properties in Dubai South.

South Bay (Phase 1 - 5) consists of 5 to 7-bedroom mansions with sizes ranging from 11,000 to 13,000 sq. ft. Moreover, there are Dubai South G+4 - G+8 plots available in various sizes.

South Bay (Phase 6) Dubai South Properties is the centerpiece of The Residential District. The development will feature over 800 villas and townhouses, 200 waterfront mansions, a one-kilometer-long crystal lagoon, and multiple beaches. The townhouses and villas within South Bay will span 2,900 to 4,800 square feet, offering a blend of 3, 4, and 5-bedroom layouts. The waterfront mansions, ranging from 5 to 7 bedrooms, will feature expansive living spaces of up to approximately 13,000 sq. ft.

Pulse Villas offers 2 to 3-bedroom townhouses and 4-bedroom semi-detached villas with spacious floor plans, enclosed kitchens, and maid quarters. It is complemented by lush green parks and designated children's play areas. Meanwhile, Pulse Apartments features large swimming pools and playgrounds, The Pulse Dubai South provides residents with ample recreational opportunities.

Pulse Townhouses is a gated community in Dubai South offering 2 to 4-bedroom townhouses, ensuring privacy and security for residents. South Living is another popular property in the area consisting of studio to 3-bedroom apartments ranging from 441 sq. ft. to 2 667 sq. ft. It is a 12-story architectural masterpiece, where a myriad of top-tier amenities await to redefine the very essence of leisure living.

Pulse Beachfront is another gated community of Dubai South villas along a sandy beach, complete with pools, private gardens, extensive green spaces, and kid-friendly activities. It features  3 to 5-bedroom semi-detached villas and 3-bedroom townhouses.

Off-Plan Projects in Dubai South

One of the off-plan properties in the area is Azizi Venice at Dubai South, a complex in the heart of the area. It features studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments. Located amongst beaches, lagoons, and water paths, the property will offer various amenities to its residents.

Another upcoming project is Celestia Dubai South. Developed by DAMAC Properties, it features studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments. Minutes away from the Al Maktoum International Airport, Celestia offers home buyers and investors an excellent investment opportunity.

Properties for Rent in Dubai South

There are many Dubai South apartments for rent available at affordable prices. The Dubai South studio for rent will cost you as little as AED 31,900, while 1-bedroom flats are priced at AED 36,000 annually. Larger 2-bedroom apartments start at AED 53,000. For 3-bedroom flats, rental rates in Dubai South typically begin at AED 95,000 annually. Meanwhile, the yearly rent for 4-bedroom apartments in Dubai South begins at AED 150,000.

You can also find various villas in the community. The annual rental rates for 2-bedroom villas in Dubai South range from AED 69,900 to AED 130,000. Meanwhile, 3-bedroom villas are available for rent between AED 84,000 and AED 195,000 per annum. Rent for 4-bedroom villas in Dubai South starts from AED 120,000 and extends up to AED 220,000. For further details, explore the rental listings for villas in Dubai South from the past 12 months.

2-bedroom townhouses for rent in Dubai South are offered at rates starting from AED 72,900. For 3-bedroom townhouses, the rental prices in Dubai South begin at AED 80,000. As for 4-bedroom townhouses, rental rates in Dubai South start from AED 120,000.

Properties for Sale in Dubai South

Studio apartments for sale in Dubai South start from AED 100,000. For 1-bedroom flats, the sale price in Dubai South begins at AED 113,000. 2-bedroom flats for sale in Dubai South are available for at least AED 212,000. The sale price for 3-bedroom apartments in Dubai South starts at AED 1.1 million. Finally, 4-bedroom flats for sale in Dubai South are priced at a minimum of AED 2.3 million.

As for studio hotel apartments, they are priced at AED 400,000. 2-bedroom hotel apartments in Dubai South can be purchased for AED 1 million. For villas, 2-bedroom homes are priced at AED 1.1 million. 3-bedroom villas in Dubai South start from AED 1.4 million. Larger 4-bedroom villas are priced from AED 1.9 million.

For townhouses, 2-bedroom options start from AED 999,000, and 3-bedroom townhouses in Dubai South are available for AED 1.1 million. Larger 4-bedroom townhouses are available for AED 1.9 million and 5-bedroom townhouses in Dubai South are priced from AED 3.4 million to AED 4.5 million.

Popular Properties in Dubai South

Some desirable destinations within Dubai South include Emaar South, Residential District, MAG 5 Boulevard, Hassani 24, and Kappa Acca 1.

Rental rates for apartments in Emaar South range from AED 50,000 to AED 150,000 annually, while the sale prices for apartments in the area span from AED 650,000 to AED 3.3 million. Villas for rent in Emaar South are priced between AED 69,900 and AED 220,000 per year, with the lowest villa purchase price starting at AED 1.1 million.

In the residential district, annual apartment rents start at AED 44,000 and reach up to AED 120,000. The minimum purchase price for an apartment in the Residential District is AED 340,000. Villas for rent in the Residential District begin at AED 110,000 for a 2-bedroom house, while the sale prices for villas in this area start from AED 1.1 million.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Emaar Dubai South?

data.answer:
Life in Emaar Dubai South offers a harmonious blend of comfort, convenience, and modernity. With its meticulously planned residential communities, residents enjoy spacious living spaces, lush green surroundings, and a host of amenities designed for relaxation and recreation. From world-class shopping destinations to fine dining experiences, Emaar Dubai South provides a vibrant lifestyle within a dynamic and thriving urban environment.

Public Transportation in Dubai South

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), and Emirates Road (E44) facilitate access from other parts of Dubai to Dubai South. Bus stops in Dubai South are served by Buses F55, N55, and 56.

Supermarkets in Dubai South

Though some projects are still in progress, Dubai South boasts a variety of supermarkets currently operational in the area, including Zoom Supermarket, Geant Express, Grand Hyper, and 24 Seven Supermarket.

Shopping Malls In and Near Dubai South

The forthcoming Expo City Mall within Dubai South's Emaar South development is poised to cater comprehensively to the shopping requirements of nearby residents. Anticipated to debut in 2024, the mall will feature an expansive array of over 190 shops and F&B outlets.

Ibn Battuta Mall is accessible within a 24-minute drive, while The Outlet Village by Meraas is situated just 20 minutes away.

Further afield, additional shopping destinations such as Dubai Marina Mall, Mall of the Emirates, and the renowned Dubai Mall are reachable within a 40-minute drive.

Schools Near Dubai South

Preschoolers can attend Tappy Toes Nursery in Dubai South, while British Oak Montessori Nursery in the neighboring community of Alghadeer offers additional options.

Nearby schools in Dubai Investments Park include Dove Green Private School (British curriculum), Greenfield International School (American curriculum), Bright Riders School (Indian curriculum), and British Columbia Canadian School (Canadian curriculum). The number of educational institutions is expected to grow as residential projects in the area reach completion.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Dubai South Area

Several mosques, including Al Maktoum Airport Mosque, are present in the area, with the expectation of further increase upon completion of residential projects in Dubai South.

While churches and temples are not located within Dubai South, practitioners of Christianity can find St. Mina Coptic Orthodox Church, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, Christ Church, and others in Jebel Ali Village, approximately a 25-minute drive away. The Sikh community can visit Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara, also within a 25-minute driving distance.

Clinics and Hospitals in Dubai South

Al Maktoum Airport Clinic and Saudi German Clinic in Dubai are easily accessible within minutes. Access Clinic Jafza is approximately a 15-minute drive away, while NMC Royal Hospital, a leading facility in Dubai, is situated about 20 minutes away in Dubai Investment Park.

Dubai South Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai South is a self-contained district surrounded by prominent areas such as Dubai Investment Park and the Jebel Ali community. This proximity ensures easy access to Dubai South's Logistics District, facilitating convenient transportation for import and export activities.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai South

data.answer:
In Dubai South, visitors and residents alike can indulge in a multitude of experiences. Explore the futuristic marvels of the Expo 2020 site, immerse yourself in the excitement of Dubai Parks and Resorts, or unwind on the pristine beaches nearby. Delve into the vibrant culinary scene, ranging from international chains to local gems. For leisure, enjoy a round of golf at the upcoming 18-hole golf course or take a peaceful stroll in the green spaces scattered throughout the city. With its blend of modernity, culture, and leisure, Dubai South offers something for everyone to enjoy.

Restaurants In and Near Dubai South

Numerous international food chains and restaurants within Dubai South are currently in operation, offering delectable cuisine. Olives Restaurant, a well-established chain with multiple branches across Dubai, is already serving customers within Dubai South. Additionally, McDonald’s remains a top choice for fast-food enthusiasts.

At The Logistics District Dubai South restaurants, diners can enjoy offerings from Skini Panini, Coffee Pushin, and Golos Italia Restaurant. For those craving Asian cuisine, Sarhad Darbar is the closest option, situated in the neighboring Dubai Investment Park.

Approximately 20 minutes away, Riverland Dubai, a component of Dubai Parks and Resorts, hosts an extensive selection of restaurants. Among the popular casual dining options in Riverland Dubai are Super Chix, Olive Garden, TGI Fridays, and The Coffee Club.

Hotels In and Near the Dubai South

Dubai South boasts several hotels, enriching the accommodation landscape in the neighborhood. Among these, notable establishments include Staybridge Suites Dubai Al-Maktoum Airport, Aloft Dubai South, and Holiday Inn Dubai Al-Maktoum Airport/

Staybridge Suites Dubai Al-Maktoum Airport stands as a prominent 4-star hotel within Dubai South. Its offerings encompass room service, a fully-equipped business center, an enticing outdoor swimming pool, a well-appointed fitness center, an on-site restaurant, a delectable buffet breakfast, and a round-the-clock front desk service.

Aloft Dubai South provides 139 guest rooms, each featuring a signature platform bed, a 49-inch LED TV complete with Chromecast, a generously sized bathroom featuring a convenient walk-in shower, and an assortment of other essential amenities. Alongside, guests can enjoy access to a 24-hour front desk, an enticing restaurant, a lively bar, a well-equipped fitness center, and a functional business center. These hotels are conveniently situated in Aviation City.

Holiday Inn Dubai Al-Maktoum Airport offers guests an array of services, including a 24-hour front desk, room service, and currency exchange facilities. Additional amenities include an inviting restaurant, a refreshing outdoor swimming pool, a modern fitness center, and complimentary private parking.

Beaches Near Dubai South

Jebel Ali Beach is one of Dubai's premier public beaches, conveniently reachable with just a 22-minute drive. For individuals seeking a tranquil stroll along the shore, Al Sufouh Beach offers an ideal destination within a half-hour drive from Dubai South. Another enticing option is JBR Beach, accessible to residents of Dubai South with just a 30-minute drive.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Dubai South

Amidst the various projects within Dubai South, the development of an 18-hole golf course ranks among the most eagerly anticipated ventures in the area. This course will be situated within the Golf District, offering residents of Emaar South villas picturesque vistas of the verdant landscape.

Dubai South also enjoys proximity to Dubai Parks and Resorts, a renowned destination comprising a collection of theme parks. These include Motiongate Dubai, Legoland, and Riverland.

Motiongate Dubai is the largest Hollywood-inspired theme park in the region, located off the Sheikh Zayed Road highway. Meanwhile, Legoland Dubai presents a captivating LEGO-themed experience, featuring interactive rides, water slides, and driving adventures. Riverland is also a vibrant recreational hub boasting over 50 restaurants, cafes, and shops. It is divided into four distinct zones: The Peninsula, India Gate, Boardwalk, and The French Village.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

In each district, designated spaces are allocated for green areas, with many residential communities incorporating expansive communal parks for the enjoyment of their residents.

As Dubai South continues to develop, numerous fitness facilities will become available. Residents seeking to pursue their fitness goals may need to explore neighboring communities. Western Gym, located within Sapphire Mall, boasts state-of-the-art equipment and professional trainers, accessible with just a 20-minute drive. Similarly, Evolve HQ Fitness, situated in The Town Mall, can be reached in approximately 21 minutes.

For some well-deserved relaxation and pampering, South Beauty Centre and Portofino Gentlemen Lounge cater to both female and male clientele within Dubai South.

Dubai South is a self-contained urban enclave, encompassing a diverse array of essential and high-end amenities. Spanning across extensive land parcels, it comprises distinct districts tailored for residential and commercial endeavors. Although some ongoing development projects within Dubai South may initially cause inconvenience for residents, the resulting expansion will ultimately enhance the area's appeal. Moreover, the current development phase has positioned property prices at the more affordable end of the spectrum, rendering Dubai South an attractive investment destination for discerning investors.

What amenities are available for residents in Dubai South?

The facilities include living away From the Flying Zone, traffic-free roads, a green community, spacious units, gated communities and a stunning beach lagoon.

Is Dubai South a good place to invest in property?

With its ongoing development projects and relatively lower property prices than other areas in Dubai, Dubai South has become an attractive destination for property investors seeking growth opportunities in the region.

How is the lifestyle in Dubai South?

Dubai South offers a modern and sustainable lifestyle experience, focusing on convenience, connectivity, and community living. Residents enjoy access to various amenities and recreational activities, making it an ideal place to live, work, and play.

data.content:
Dubai South is a mixed-use development home to Al Maktoum International Airport. The eight districts serve residential, commercial, logistics, aviation, hospitality, and leisure purposes, making it a thriving community spearheaded by the UAE government.

The area consists of various residential sub-communities offering a range of housing options, from apartments, and townhouses to villas and gated compounds. These communities are designed to accommodate different lifestyles and preferences, providing residents with modern amenities, recreational facilities, and green spaces.

Dubai South is home to business districts dedicated to aviation, aerospace, and logistics industries, such as the Aviation District and the Logistics District. These districts offer state-of-the-art infrastructure, office spaces, and support services to attract businesses and stimulate economic growth.
